rv.q: Still, it zips along cheerily enough, and compared with We Will Rock You, it's a work of untrammelled genius.
Forget girl power, what you really, really want from this show is more silly moments.
That I found Viva Forever! at all tolerable is a tribute to the craft and assiduity of scriptwriter Jennifer Saunders and producer Judy Craymer.

cn.t: Critics give Viva Forever a thumbs down, with scores averaging in the low-to-mid 40s-50s. The Spice Girls jukebox musical disappoints, drawing unfavorable comparisons to other jukebox shows and failing to rise above its formulaic plot.
